verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS invoicing product, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant in the Stripe Dashboard or Invoicing. The official MCP server only lets external AI agents call the Stripe API. That is a separate MCP-server capability and does not count as a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
